provenanceNote: Norway and Denmark do not collide. Denmark's CPR number is ten digits, optionally hyphenated after six; Norway's D-number is eleven digits with no separator, and a length cannot be both. Deliberately a D-number rather than a fodselsnummer, so this pair is checked against the Norwegian scheme whose written day (41-71) is furthest from anything Denmark accepts -- Denmark would read a leading 41 as the forty-first of a month. detect() reports exactly one scheme, which is the assertion. Day 41 (01 + 40), Skatteetaten's D-number day offset, and month 83 (03 + 80), its synthetic-test marker. A written month of 81-92 is not a calendar month, so no bearer can exist -- CLAUDE.md's Exception 1. From spec/sources/norway-synthetic/generated.csv; allowSyntheticNumbers is opted in for the reason every Norwegian fixture opts in.
